points.text: lines drawn are radial from the surface
field lines show force (on satellite) is towards centre of planet or velocity of satellite is perpendicular to field lines
(gravitational) force perpendicular to velocity causes centripetal acceleration
a = rω² and ω = 2π / T or a = v² / r and v = 2πr / T or a = 4π²r / T²
identification of the two forces acting on the object as gravitational force and (normal) contact force
gravitational force and normal contact force are in opposite directions, and their resultant causes the (centripetal) acceleration
